name: Do I need to do anything to prepare my home before you start painting?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to do anything to prepare my home before you start painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: To help us work efficiently, we recommend moving smaller items and fragile decorations from the rooms to be painted. You don't need to move large furniture; we will cover and protect all remaining items and flooring. If there are specific areas of concern or items you'd like us to pay special attention to, please let us know during our pre-project walkthrough.
acceptedAnswer.description: Please move small, fragile items; we will cover and protect large furniture and flooring.
